poses.label: Slight Down
poses.prompt: eye-level head-and-shoulders portrait, head gently bowed forward without sideways roll, chin lowered toward the upper chest, face and gaze directed down toward the floor rather than at the camera
poses.geometry_prompt: natural 20 degree forward head pitch from the neck, a small amount of the top plane of the hair visible, mild natural facial foreshortening, nose angled down, eyes lowered without eye contact, camera level with the shoulders rather than above the subject, level relaxed shoulders, anatomically normal face

prompt_replacements.eyes looking directly at camera: eyes looking down at the floor with no eye contact

poses.review_rule: Require a natural approximately 20 degree bowed head with the face and gaze directed toward the floor, mild natural foreshortening, level relaxed shoulders, normal facial anatomy, and identity preserved. Reject eye contact, a face aimed toward the camera, a level or upward-facing head, an overhead/high camera angle masquerading as head pitch, distorted or compressed facial features, hunched shoulders, or a chin completely hidden against the chest.

poses.review_rule: Require a natural 10 to 15 degree upward head pitch with level relaxed shoulders, no sideways roll, both eyes readable, and identity preserved. Reject a level or downward-facing head, hunched or raised shoulders, or an extreme upward angle.
